claim: On this host on 2026-09-30, Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 launched by agent-browser 0.38.1, by Playwright 1.63.0 (the headless shell and its CLI Chromium configurations, headless and offscreen) and directly (headless and offscreen full browser) did not deliver a fetch, an image or an iframe request from a page placed in the public address space (--ip-address-space-overrides=127.0.0.1:<page port>=public) to a loopback listener on another port without a permission grant: Chromium's Local Network Access blocked all three in each of the six configurations. With the override off, and with --disable-features=LocalNetworkAccessChecks, all three requests reached the listener, so the probe could see a delivered request. playwright-cli 0.1.21 on Playwright 1.64.0-alpha, the manifest pin, was not found installed and was not measured.
limitations: One host, one Chromium build (153.0.8010.12), two listeners started by the measurement itself on loopback inside an isolated network namespace; no existing service and neither OmniRoute gateway was contacted.

agent-browser ran with its documented --executable-path and --args options and a CDP pipe transport instead of its ordinary TCP CDP endpoint, which the measurement's endpoint rules excluded; its page context and default flags were otherwise used.

Measured: fetch, image and iframe requests from a public-address-space page. Not measured: main-frame navigations and popups (which Chromium's Local Network Access does not gate), pages in the private address space, a user or tool permission grant, other Chromium versions, and the manifest-pinned playwright-cli 0.1.21.
The measurement shows whether an HTTP request reached the listener; it does not show whether Chromium opened a TCP connection before refusing.
evidence_class: independent observation: a local measurement with a positive control (override off) and a diagnostic control (Local Network Access disabled), run by a GPT-6 worker (gpt-6-astra, effort max) through the OmniRoute gateway lane; scripts published
